claims.text: Contraindicated in complete biliary obstruction (bile not secreted into the intestine).
claims.quote: QUESTRAN is contraindicated in patients with complete biliary obstruction where bile is not secreted into the intestine

claims.text: Take other drugs at least one hour before or 4 to 6 hours after cholestyramine.
claims.quote: IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT PATIENTS TAKE OTHER DRUGS AT LEAST ONE HOUR BEFORE OR 4 TO 6 HOURS AFTER QUESTRAN (OR AT AS GREAT AN INTERVAL AS POSSIBLE) TO AVOID IMPEDING THEIR ABSORPTION.
